animatedRenderReferences.motionObservation: 39 retained visible tracks radiate outward from near card center and grow during their observed windows. WebP presentation timestamps are not verified engine timing.
animatedRenderReferences.sizeComparisonObservation: Production GPU radius quantiles approach the public short sequence after separating phase and size populations; sizes only, unmatched scene and card aspect, no full-game 1:1 acceptance.

animatedRenderReferences.observation: Ordinary Wasp render; requested Doodlepool particles are absent.

animatedRenderReferences.contourObservation: Two exposed junction regions use approximate aperture registration and separate reference/production white thresholds. Four-pixel silhouette F1 improves locally; not a full-surface or full-motion fidelity score.
animatedRenderReferences.reflectionObservation: Curved silk stays in material coordinates; silver sweep responds to time and view. One silver patch mean RGB error improves from 124.06 to 9.80; dark patches remain under-calibrated.

animatedRenderReferences.observation: Official continuous footage provides multiple trails triggers and a crystal reveal-to-idle transition. Finite source interval does not establish exact engine lifetime, spin law, or same-scene pixel acceptance.
